identity_check: Confirmed as creator.ventures, the New York pre-seed and seed consumer-internet fund founded by Caspar Lee and Sasha Kaletsky (Business Wire release via Silicon UK, TechCrunch). Not Creator Fund (UK/European science pre-deck fund), not Creative Ventures, not CreatorLed Ventures.

open_items: Only 2 rounds confirmed; none found from the last 12 months (latest Deduction, Nov 2025). Search summaries listed other deals (e.g. Seal Robotics pre-seed, led by 'Creator Fund', a different firm) which were not confirmed.
Deduction lead: Techli and StartupBeat name One Way Ventures and Creator Ventures as co-leads; a database listing said Creator led alone. Dates are article dates (CB Insights listed 2025-11-14).

creator.ventures itself (and Business Wire) could not be fetched; website URL comes from the press release text. HQ is New York per the release; one directory says London. Fund II total AUM $65M per release (search summary of another source said $45M).
Fund II date is the announcement date (2025-05-20); lead matched. No application URL or cold-inbound policy found.
